description: This file implements the ApplicationAndroid class, managing Android-specific application lifecycle events, input events, window handling, deep links, and system events within the Cobalt project. It interfaces with Android system components via JNI and ALooper, and handles commands such as window creation/destruction, focus changes, deep links, and input injection.

classes.name: ApplicationAndroid
classes.description: Manages Android application lifecycle, input, window, and system events, interfacing with JNI and Android system components within the Cobalt project.

methods.name: ProcessAndroidCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming Android commands such as window creation/destruction, focus changes, and deep links, updating application state accordingly.

methods.name: SendAndroidCommand
methods.description: Sends commands to the Android event loop, managing synchronization for resource-related commands.

methods.name: SendAndroidMotionEvent
methods.description: Processes motion events received from Android OS and queues them for input handling.

methods.name: SendAndroidKeyEvent
methods.description: Processes key events received from Android OS and queues them for input handling.

methods.name: ProcessKeyboardInject
methods.description: Handles injected keyboard events from other parts of the system.

methods.name: SendKeyboardInject
methods.description: Injects a keyboard event into the input system.

methods.name: HandleDeepLink
methods.description: Handles deep link URLs received from Android intents.

methods.name: SendLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Injects a low memory warning event.

methods.name: SendDateTimeConfigurationChangedEvent
methods.description: Injects a timezone or date/time configuration change event.

methods.name: OsNetworkStatusChange
methods.description: Handles changes in network connectivity status.

methods.name: GetOverlayedIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer overlay variable value via JNI.

methods.name: GetOverlayedStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string overlay variable value via JNI.

methods.name: GetOverlayedBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean overlay variable value via JNI.
